A On the other hand, some people say that owners of wild animals take good care of their pets. B Furthermore, keeping wild animals as pets can be unhealthy for the animals - and dangerous for their owners! C First of all, it's cruel to take away a wild animal's freedom. MAQOLA (shimpanze surati): '"Wild animals should not be kept as pets." Do you agree? In my opinion, it is completely wrong to keep wild animals as pets. [1] ...... Animals such as cats and dogs usually enjoy living with humans, but wild animals don't. They need to live a natural life in their natural habitat, and they need open spaces where they can move freely. [2] ...... Animals kept in a small house or flat cannot get the exercise they need. It is also difficult to give them the same food that they eat in the wild. Also, many wild animals are dangerous and might suddenly attack their owners. [3] ...... They look after the animals, and give them love and protection. However, wild animals don't want our love and protection - they want their freedom. All in all, I believe that wild animals should not be kept as pets, because every animal has the right to live freely in its natural environment.'

exercises.instructionEn: "Wild animals should not be kept as pets." Do you agree? (opinion article, 5 paragraphs)
exercises.instructionUz: "Yovvoyi hayvonlarni uy hayvoni sifatida saqlamaslik kerak." Rozimisiz? (fikr maqolasi, 5 xatboshi)
exercises.explanationUz:
FIKR MAQOLASI (opinion article) -
  coursebook 103-bet rejasi.

TUZILISh (5 xatboshi):
  1 KIRISh - mavzu + yozuvchi
    fikri ('In my opinion, it is
    completely wrong ...')
  2 1-DALIL (First of all) -
    erkinlik
  3 2-DALIL (Furthermore) -
    sog'liq, xavf
  4 QARShI FIKR (On the other
    hand) + rad etish (However)
  5 XULOSA (All in all) - fikr
    takrori


⚠ BOG'LOVChILAR:

  First of all - avvalo
  Furthermore - bundan tashqari
  On the other hand - boshqa
    tomondan
  However - ammo
  All in all - umuman olganda


⚠ 'CRUEL':

  = shafqatsiz.


⚠ 'FREEDOM':

  = erkinlik.


⚠ 'PERSONALITY':

  = shaxsiyat, xarakter.


⚠ 'IN THE WILD':

  = yovvoyi tabiatda.


⚠ 'THE RIGHT TO':

  = ... huquqi.

points.en: Wild animals such as chimpanzees, parrots and even pythons are wonderful to watch and have interesting personalities - but should people keep them as pets? In my opinion, it is completely wrong to keep wild animals as pets.
points.uz: Shimpanze, to'tiqush va hatto piton kabi yovvoyi hayvonlarni tomosha qilish ajoyib va ularning qiziqarli xarakteri bor - lekin odamlar ularni uy hayvoni sifatida saqlashi kerakmi? Mening fikrimcha, yovvoyi hayvonlarni uy hayvoni sifatida saqlash mutlaqo noto'g'ri.
points.noteUz: ⚠ PARA 1 - KIRISh: mavzu + FIKR ('In my opinion').

points.en: [C] First of all, it's cruel to take away a wild animal's freedom. Animals such as cats and dogs usually enjoy living with humans, but wild animals don't. They need to live a natural life in their natural habitat, and they need open spaces where they can move freely.
points.uz: [C] Avvalo, yovvoyi hayvonning erkinligini tortib olish shafqatsizlik. Mushuk va it kabi hayvonlar odatda odamlar bilan yashashdan zavqlanadi, lekin yovvoyi hayvonlar - yo'q. Ular tabiiy yashash muhitida tabiiy hayot kechirishi kerak va erkin harakatlana oladigan ochiq joylarga muhtoj.
points.noteUz: ⚠ PARA 2 - 1-DALIL: erkinlik. Bo'shliq 1 → C ('First of all').

points.en: [B] Furthermore, keeping wild animals as pets can be unhealthy for the animals - and dangerous for their owners! Animals kept in a small house or flat cannot get the exercise they need. It is also difficult to give them the same food that they eat in the wild. Also, many wild animals are dangerous and might suddenly attack their owners.
points.uz: [B] Bundan tashqari, yovvoyi hayvonlarni uy hayvoni sifatida saqlash hayvonlar uchun zararli - va egalari uchun xavfli bo'lishi mumkin! Kichik uy yoki kvartirada saqlanadigan hayvonlar kerakli harakatni ololmaydi. Ularga yovvoyi tabiatda yeydigan ovqatni berish ham qiyin. Shuningdek, ko'p yovvoyi hayvonlar xavfli va to'satdan egalariga hujum qilishi mumkin.
points.noteUz: ⚠ PARA 3 - 2-DALIL: sog'liq va xavf. Bo'shliq 2 → B ('Furthermore').

points.en: [A] On the other hand, some people say that owners of wild animals take good care of their pets. They look after the animals, and give them love and protection. However, wild animals don't want our love and protection - they want their freedom.
points.uz: [A] Boshqa tomondan, ba'zilar yovvoyi hayvon egalari o'z hayvonlariga yaxshi g'amxo'rlik qiladi deyishadi. Ular hayvonlarga qaraydi, mehr va himoya beradi. Ammo yovvoyi hayvonlar bizning mehr va himoyamizni xohlamaydi - ular erkinlikni xohlaydi.
points.noteUz: ⚠ PARA 4 - QARShI FIKR + rad etish. Bo'shliq 3 → A ('On the other hand').

points.en: All in all, I believe that wild animals should not be kept as pets, because every animal has the right to live freely in its natural environment.
points.uz: Umuman olganda, yovvoyi hayvonlarni uy hayvoni sifatida saqlamaslik kerak deb hisoblayman, chunki har bir hayvon o'z tabiiy muhitida erkin yashash huquqiga ega.

items.question: What is the writer's personal opinion about keeping wild animals as pets? Where does the writer state this opinion?
items.answer: The writer thinks it is completely wrong to keep wild animals as pets. This opinion is stated in the introduction (paragraph 1) and repeated in the conclusion (paragraph 5).

modelAnswers:
"Animals should not be kept in zoos." Do you agree?

Most people enjoy going to the zoo and looking at the animals - but do the animals enjoy it? I think they are often unhappy and unhealthy. In my opinion, it is completely wrong to keep animals in zoos.

First of all, it's cruel to take away an animal's freedom. Animals in zoos are often kept alone in small cages and they can't move freely. Many of them become so bored and unhappy that they die.

Furthermore, zoos can be unhealthy places for animals. The animals can't get the exercise they need and it is difficult to give them the food they eat in the wild. Also, the weather conditions may be unsuitable - for example, it may be too cold for lions or not cold enough for polar bears.

On the other hand, some people say that zoos can help to protect animals. Animals in zoos are safe from hunters, and species which can't survive in the wild can be bred in captivity. However, it would be better to save and protect the animals' natural habitats.

All in all, I believe that animals should not be kept in zoos, because every animal has the right to live freely in its natural environment.

Avvalo, hayvonning erkinligini tortib olish shafqatsizlik. Hayvonot bog'idagi hayvonlar ko'pincha kichik qafaslarda yolg'iz saqlanadi va erkin harakatlana olmaydi. Ko'plari shu qadar zerikib, baxtsiz bo'ladiki, o'lib ketadi.

Bundan tashqari, hayvonot bog'lari hayvonlar uchun zararli joy bo'lishi mumkin. Hayvonlar kerakli harakatni ololmaydi va ularga yovvoyi tabiatda yeydigan ovqatni berish qiyin. Hayvonot bog'idagi hayvonlar ovchilardan xavfsiz va yovvoyi tabiatda yashay olmaydigan turlar asirlikda ko'paytirilishi mumkin. Ammo hayvonlarning tabiiy yashash muhitini saqlash va himoya qilish yaxshiroq bo'lardi.

Umuman olganda, hayvonlarni hayvonot bog'ida saqlamaslik kerak deb hisoblayman, chunki har bir hayvon o'z tabiiy muhitida erkin yashash huquqiga ega.
